_comment: KiviDB's own arities, for scripts/gen_arity.py: commands Valkey does not have, and commands KiviDB takes in a different form from Valkey's. Each is the number of arguments KiviDB's handler takes, the command's name included; negative is a minimum. Each replaces Valkey's entry of the same name, if there is one.

CLUSTER|REPLICATE.why: KiviDB takes a node ID only (src/commands/cluster.rs cmd_replicate), not Valkey 9's NO ONE form.

SCRIPT|DEBUG.why: KiviDB takes the mode only (src/commands/lua.rs), not Valkey 9.1's optional engine name.

XIDMPRECORD.why: Not in Valkey. XIDMPRECORD key producer-id idempotent-id entry-id (src/commands/streams.rs xidmprecord).
